title: Immersion feedback and hiring pulse — Nov 25 2025
content:
Summary:
This doc captures the weekly hiring + onboarding pulse focused on the Immersion program (week 0–4), plus interview panel debrief highlights from last two recruiter rounds. The goal: short list of action items to reduce time-to-fully-productive for ICs in serving-runtime and platform-engineering, and small process fixes to improve interview signal quality.

Meeting context:
- Weekly sync: Engineering Onboarding Council — 2025-11-24, 10:00am PT (30m)
- Attendees: Samira P (notes), Jonah L, Priya M, Omar R, Cassidy N, plus QA buddy volunteers: Alex W, Maya K
- Focus: 1) Immersion program progress for cohort Nov 3 intake; 2) Interview panel calibration after two recent on-site loops; 3) Hiring metric check-in.

Immersion (cohort Nov 3) quick status:
- 6 new engineers started (2 serving-runtime, 2 console-and-tooling, 2 platform-eng).
- Week mapping: Week 0 (orientation) complete; Week 1 (team rotations + shadowing) ~80% finished; Week 2 (mini-project kickoff) started for serving-runtime cohort.
- Wins: automated DevEnv overlay reduced first-run failures from ~45% -> 12% for cohort machines; buddy pairing established for all new hires.
- Pain points observed (from new hire check-ins):
  - Access delays: 2 people still missing k8s-read role due to ticket backlog (JIRA-ENG-4321). Blocking ability to run local inference tests.
  - Onboarding docs mismatch: 'runtime-troubleshooting.md' has steps referencing legacy CUDA env vars — causing confusion during environment setup.
  - Mini-project scope: serving-runtime mini-project too broad for 2-week window; expectation mismatch.

Immersion action items (owners + target):
- Priority A: Fix k8s role provisioning backlog — Omar R to coordinate with infra SRE team; escalate if not resolved by 2025-11-28.
- Priority A: Patch onboarding repo: remove legacy CUDA references and add short checklist for common env issues — Cassidy N to open PR, target 2025-11-27. Linked: github PR forthcoming.
- Priority B: Narrow serving-runtime mini-project to a focused 'latency profiling' slice; Jonah L to provide new project brief + success criteria by 2025-12-01.
- Priority B: Buddy sync cadence — formalize 1x/week 30m check-ins for first month, established by Priya M.

Interview panel debrief (recent loops):
- Loops run: 2025-11-18 and 2025-11-20 for Senior Inferencing Engineer (serving-runtime).
- Panel composition varied; common panelists: Priya M (system design), Alex W (model runtime), Cassidy N (culture + org fit).
- Candidates: one strong pass (candidate A — verbal offer extended), two borderline (B, C) with follow-ups requested, one declined after poor system design answers.
- Calibration notes from panel:
  - System design rubric: panelists diverged on expected breadth vs depth. Priya suggested adding a 'localization of depth' note to scoring: expect deep treatment of one core area plus lighter notes on integrations.
  - Practical runtime test: current take-home exercise takes ~10–14 hours which disproportionately favors candidates with free time; propose moving to 3–4 hour focused exercise + short live pairing.
  - Interviewer preparation: several panelists reported inconsistent pre-read coverage (candidate repo + CV). Recruiters to ensure one-line summary + expected areas for each interviewer.

Interview process action items:
- Short take-home redesign: Priya M + Alex W to draft condensed exercise and pilot with internal volunteer by 2025-12-04.
- Panel rubric update: create a 1-page calibration guide (depth-localization and scoring bands). Cassidy N to author and circulate by 2025-11-30.
- Interviewer pre-reads: ask recruiting to include 'interview brief' template before each loop; Samira to follow-up with Talent Ops (linked ticket CONFSRV-1289).

Hiring metrics snapshot (as discussed):
- Pipeline: 18 active senior IC candidates across serving-runtime and platform-eng.
- Time-to-offer (median for last 6 hires): 31 days. Target to reduce to 25 days over next quarter.
- Offer acceptance rate (last 90 days): 62% — primary decline reasons: comp, remote location, perceived onboarding ramp.

Team health and signals:
- Survey pulse (anonymous week 3 check for new cohort): 4.0/5 average on 'feeling supported'; 3.2/5 average on 'clarity of ramp expectations'.
- Manager notes: early signs of onboarding fatigue in platform-eng pairing sessions (sessions >2h tended to be unproductive). Recommendation: shorten pairing blocks to 90 min.

Risks and unresolved questions:
- If k8s access delays persist, mini-project outcomes will be delayed and confidence scores will drop for managers.
- Does recruiting have bandwidth to coordinate pre-read templates and take-home redesign at scale? Need confirmation from Talent Ops.

Follow-ups and next steps (owners + due):
- Omar R: escalate infra ticket for k8s roles if not resolved by 2025-11-28.
- Cassidy N: PR to onboarding docs by 2025-11-27; draft calibration guide by 2025-11-30.
- Jonah L: updated mini-project brief by 2025-12-01; will include acceptance criteria and minimal reproducible test harness.
- Priya M & Alex W: condensed take-home pilot plan by 2025-12-04.
- Samira P: sync with Talent Ops on pre-read template and bandwidth; update CONFSRV-1289 by 2025-11-26.

Notes to self / rough ideas for next meeting:
- Try 90-min pairing blocks and capture feedback via short form (3 questions).
- Consider creating a small 'onboarding smoke test' CI job that runs a canonical small workload to validate new hire environments after access provisioning (would catch env issues early).
- Capture a short video walkthrough (5–7m) from SRE showing the common k8s commands new hires will use.

Appendix: sample feedback snippets from new hires (anonymized):
- "Bootstrapping the dev env took longer than expected; the guide assumes CUDA 12 but my VM was on 11.x."
- "My buddy was great but meetings were long and unfocused; a checklist before calls would help."
- "Mini-project felt too open — would prefer a narrower measurable goal."

If you want to triage any of these items in the next 1:1s or want me to pull a short board of affected hires, flag here and I'll add to the agenda.

End of notes.
